afterTurnA.findingType: Scenario expectation failure, not an early-fetch product defect: A had already intersected before the filler streamed.

mechanicalConclusion.reason: A was fully visible before the 120 filler paragraphs existed. Auto-follow then moved it above the viewport. The later offscreen state is not a never-visible state. No-refetch passed, but the zero-before-first-entry checkpoint was not constructed.
